package.name: go2_detector
package.description: Thin YOLO11n CPU detector for the Unitree Go2 patrol SUT (cv-infra consumer fixture): /camera/image_raw -> /detections (vision_msgs/Detection2DArray). Mission-agnostic — it publishes every class it sees; target selection belongs to the tracker (U3). torch (CPU wheel) + ultralytics are pip dependencies pinned in ../../constraints-detector.txt; the weights are sealed into the SUT image at build time (decision 2026-08-31 D1-A), never downloaded at runtime.
